medina.title: Medina & Ramparts
medina.desc: Blue-and-white alleys, city walls and ocean views.

port.title: Port & Skala du Port
port.desc: Working harbour, blue boats and grilled fish stalls.

beach.title: Essaouira Beach
beach.desc: Long sandy bay for walks, kitesurf and sunset.

skala.title: Skala de la Ville
skala.desc: Cannons and panoramic views over medina and ocean.

souks.title: Artisan Souks
souks.desc: Thuya wood, silver, argan and galleries.

gnaoua.title: Gnaoua Heritage
gnaoua.desc: Spiritual music tradition and festival city.

square.title: Place Moulay Hassan
square.desc: Main square between medina and port.

mogador.title: Mogador Islands
mogador.desc: Protected islands offshore — views from the ramparts.
